verdict.rationale: Bitbucket's product docs explicitly say you can open a repository, navigate to the Security tab, and install the Snyk integration for automatic security scans. They also mention connecting other providers, and third-party code reports appear in PRs. Missing for 10: evidence that providers other than Snyk can be installed directly from the Security tab, in-depth setup documentation beyond marketing copy, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
